facts.business: Palm Jewels Limited is engaged in the wholesale business of gold jewellery, selling gold chains, silver ornaments, bracelets, and necklaces through B2B channels across Gujarat, with manufacturing outsourced to job workers in Ahmedabad and Mumbai.
key_risks: Business risk: High dependence on any one business for revenues
Legal & Statutory Risk: Compliance with laws across jurisdictions
Human resource attrition risk: Challenge to retain talent in competitive market
Others: Exposure to foreign exchange rate fluctuations, raw material price volatility, and overseas investment exposures
